messages:
Maria G: Quick sprint check for hotpath perf — need owners for two linchpin integrations and canary plan. Goal: stabilize p99 latency by EOW.

Maria G: Items:
- kernel: API v2 handshake compatibility with continuous batching
- kv: prefetch backpressure + eviction tuning
- ops: canary rollout + rollback criteria

Kevin T: I'll own kernel API v2 handshake. PR in draft: #612. Need @Alex R to run compatibility harness.

Alex R: Ack. Running e2e now, hitting sequence leak in continuous batching when kv prefetch is enabled. Paste log:
```
error: seq-cache mismatch at step=8 (expected 2048, got 1984)
stack: runtime/kernel/seq_cache.cc:142
```

Dmitri P: I'll take KV prefetch/backpressure. Blocker: infra flag to enable per-tenant backpressure. I've got a proposed config:
```
backpressure:
  enabled: true
  threshold: 0.75
  eviction_target: 0.6
```

Lucy Z: I'll own canary plan + rollout ops. Need a 2-hr early window and rollback checkpoints. Proposed criteria: increase in p99 > 10% OR evictions > 50/min -> rollback.

Maria G: Thanks. Targets: Kernel PR ready for review by Thu COB, KV config in staging by Fri morning, canary Wed 10–12 PST. Sound reasonable? :thinking:

Kevin T: Working on test fixtures. Pinged reviewers @Lucy Z @Dmitri P. Two approvals required.

Alex R: Found race root cause — kv prefetch is racing with KV cache warmup epoch. Filed issue #1423 and added a minimal repro.

Dmitri P: FYI metrics: in current staging run evictions spike at threshold 0.8 — lowering to 0.75 keeps avg mem ~ stable. Will post graphs in #monitoring.

deploy-bot: canary deployment started: runtime-canary-2026-03-17-01 -> 2 instances

Lucy Z: Scheduling canary Wed 10:00 PST confirmed. Will follow rollback criteria and run step-size ramp (10% -> 50% -> 100%).

Maria G: Action items:
- Kevin: PR #612 ready for review (Thu)
- Alex: E2E fix & repro on #1423 (tomorrow)
- Dmitri: KV flag + staging config (Fri)
- Lucy: Canary playbook + ops checklists (Mon)

Maria G: If anything slips, call it out here. Otherwise I'll update the sprint board. :thumbsup:
